title: Preview of a ticket form
purpose: See the fields a client fills for a ticket form, without sending anything.
summary: The form as a client sees it, empty and read-only. Nothing you do here is saved or sent. Only the admin role can open this page.

tasks.title: Check what a client is asked
steps: Read the fields in order, with their help text, options and the instructions at the top.
Select [[Back to the form]] to change a field.

tasks.title: Find a field that is missing
steps: Open [[Back to the form]] and check the field's [[Who fills it]], whether it is active, and its type.

good_to_know: The preview is for reading. The fields are disabled and no ticket is created.
Only active fields that clients fill are shown. Fields that staff fill or that are staff only do not appear.
The portal adds the site, a reference, a subject, a description and the urgent box around these fields. They are not part of the preview.

items.label: Instructions
items.description: The form's instructions, when it has any, above the fields.

items.label: Fields
items.description: Each active field that clients fill, in the form's order, with its label, help text and input: text boxes, number, date and time inputs, options as buttons or a list, yes or no, a confirmation box, or the quantity boxes of an item list. All of them are disabled.

items.label: No client fields
items.description: Shown when the form has no active field that clients fill. Clients then see only the portal's usual fields for this form.
